question: A system administrator cannot start a queue manager QMA on AIX and has been requested by IBM Support to provide an MQ detailed early trace. There is only one installation on this system with two queue managers, QMA and QMB. To capture an early detailed trace, which command does the system administrator need to issue before trying to start the QMA queue manager? A. strmqtrc –e –t all –t detail B. strmqtrc –e –m QMA –t detail C. strmqtrc –m QMA –t all –t detail D. strmqtrc –m QMA –e –t all –t detail
